name: Warp Build

check.label: Warp app → Settings → Billing and usage

meters.label: Included usage
meters.hint: $20 a month. In Warp: Settings → Billing and usage shows balance and reset date.

reset.rule: Resets every 30 days from your subscription or renewal date, monthly even on yearly billing.
stipulations: Inference that Warp provides is priced at public API rates.
Cloud agent compute costs $0.0015 per vCPU-minute on Linux and double on Windows. Cloud runs add platform charges.
Plain shell commands are free. Generate and AI Autofill spend usage.
Unused included usage doesn't carry over. Purchased usage does, for 12 months.

overage: At the limit, AI stops unless you buy more. Buy once or turn on auto-reload, which is off by default. One monthly spend limit covers the whole team, and Warp says it isn't a guaranteed ceiling.

how: $20 of agent usage a month at API rates, plus compute and platform charges for cloud runs.
ext: Bring your own OpenAI, Anthropic or Google key on any plan. The provider bills it, though Warp compute and platform charges can still apply.
Connect a ChatGPT subscription for OpenAI models or an xAI account for Grok.
Works in the Warp app and the Warp Agent CLI.
quirks: Warp moved from credits to dollars in October 2026. Old credit packs kept their face value or inference value, whichever was higher.
Downgrades apply at once. You get a prorated account balance, not your unused usage.
Usage for older runs may show as unavailable. That doesn't mean the run was free.
Claude Fable models need data retention on, even with Help improve Warp off.
